title: Exam answers not saving
alert: Autosave failing for learner rohan.s@outlook.com during mid-term exams
root cause: mid-term exams used the shared Redis instead of the dedicated exam Redis
fix: Extended the exam window, raised redis-exam maxmemory, moved sessions to the dedicated Redis and replayed the autosave journal

title: Uploaded lectures not processing
alert: transcoder queue backlog 3,412 videos; consumer lag 3 hours
root cause: One corrupt upload kept failing and blocked the queue because it retried forever
fix: Moved the corrupt file to a dead-letter queue and set a max retry count of 5

title: Gradebook not saving marks
alert: grades-db lock wait timeout; teachers unable to save marks after semester finals
root cause: A heavy analytics report ran on the primary grades database
fix: Killed the report and moved analytics to the read replica

title: Live classes buffering
alert: media-edge rebuffer ratio 18% for 3,412 learners; origin egress at 100%
root cause: A CDN config change disabled the origin shield so every viewer pulled video from origin
fix: Re-enabled the origin shield and moved the south region to the secondary CDN until load settled

title: Webcam check failing before exams
alert: proctor-service webcam permission check failing for Chrome users before mid-term exams
root cause: A Chrome update changed the camera permission API used by our proctoring SDK
fix: Upgraded the proctoring SDK and added a manual camera test fallback

title: Fee payments stuck as pending
alert: fee-payments webhook signature verification failed; 2,300 payments pending
root cause: The payment gateway webhook secret was rotated but not updated in fee-payments
failed fixes: Asking learners to pay again (caused double charges)
fix: Updated the webhook secret, reconciled pending payments and refunded duplicates

title: Webcam check failing before exams
alert: proctor-service webcam permission check failing for Chrome users before the Sunday mock test
root cause: A Chrome update changed the camera permission API used by our proctoring SDK
fix: Upgraded the proctoring SDK and added a manual camera test fallback

title: Class timetable shifted by hours
alert: Timetable shows classes 5.5 hours late for 3,412 learners
root cause: The timetable sync wrote UTC times into a field the app reads as IST
fix: Re-ran the sync with IST conversion and added a timezone test

title: Exam answers not saving
alert: exam-service autosave 409 session not found during semester finals; redis-exam used_memory 99%
root cause: The Redis session store ran out of memory and evicted live exam sessions
fix: Extended the exam window, raised redis-exam maxmemory, moved sessions to the dedicated Redis and replayed the autosave journal
